6.10
Citation Result
Every generated response includes citations indicating the document name and page
number from which the information was retrieved.
This significantly improves transparency and enables users to verify generated answers
directly from the original research documents.
6.11
Performance Evaluation
The developed application demonstrated satisfactory performance during experimental
evaluation.
Major observations include:
• Fast document upload
• Efficient text extraction
• Accurate chunk generation
• High semantic retrieval accuracy
• Fast response generation
• Reliable citation generation
• Secure authentication
• Simple user interface
6.12
Advantages of the Developed System
The developed Intelligent Research Assistant provides several advantages.
• AI-powered research assistance
• Fast semantic document search
• Local LLM execution using Ollama
• Privacy-preserving architecture
• Citation-supported responses
• Modular implementation
